text: Deadlines can feel stressful, but handling them well mostly comes down to good habits. First, practice time management by breaking a big project into smaller daily tasks and starting early. Next, learn prioritization; not everything is equally urgent, so focus on what truly moves the project forward and do that first. Also, be honest about scope management—if a task is too large, simplify it or clearly define what “done” means rather than trying to do everything. Finally, keep communication open. If you think you will be late, tell your team or manager as soon as possible; often, they can adjust expectations or offer help. Regular updates build trust and reduce last-minute surprises.
